added.description:
About Us:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in software engineering, logical reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Ideal Background:

This role is ideal for engineers who have built production systems at companies like Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Meta, or similar high-scale engineering organizations. We especially welcome graduates from top computer science programs such as Stanford, MIT, Carnegie Mellon, UC Berkeley, Georgia Tech, and comparable institutions — though exceptional experience and skill always take precedence over pedigree.

Project Overview:

As a Software Engineering evaluator, you will create cutting-edge datasets for training, benchmarking, and advancing large language models, collaborating closely with researchers. This includes curating code examples, providing precise solutions, and making corrections — with a primary focus on Python across backend services, data pipelines, and ML infrastructure, alongside JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C++, Java, Rust, and Go. You will evaluate and refine AI-generated code for efficiency, scalability, and reliability, and work with cross-functional teams to enhance enterprise-level AI-driven coding solutions.

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

Work on AI model training initiatives by curating code examples, building solutions, and correcting code — primarily in Python, with additional work in JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C++, Java, Rust, and Go.
Evaluate and refine AI-generated code to ensure that it is efficient, scalable, and reliable.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance AI-driven coding solutions against industry performance benchmarks.
Build agents and automated verification tools in Python that can verify the quality of code and identify error patterns.
Hypothesize on steps in the software engineering cycle (prototyping, architecture design, API design, production implementation, launch, experiments, monitoring, operational maintenance) and evaluate model capabilities on them.
Design verification mechanisms that can automatically verify a solution to a software engineering task.

Required Skills:

Several years of software engineering experience (3 years or more)
Strong expertise in Python with deep knowledge of frameworks, tooling, and best practices for building production-grade software.
Experience building full-stack applications and deploying scalable software using modern languages and tools.
Deep understanding of software architecture, design, development, debugging, and code quality/review assessment.
Excellent oral and written communication skills for clear, structured evaluation rationales.

Commitment: flexible engagement, minimum 10 hrs/week, up to 40 hrs/week
Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave)
Duration: 1 month (potential extensions based on performance and fit)
Location: Candidates must be based in the United States

added.title: Electrical Automation Engineer
added.description:
Company Description
SIEMAG TECBERG Inc. is part of a global engineering group that delivers specialized mechanical and electrical solutions for industrial applications. The company focuses on advanced hoisting, material handling, and automation technologies that support safe, efficient, and reliable operations. Team members collaborate across disciplines to design, implement, and maintain high-performance systems for a wide range of customers. SIEMAG TECBERG Inc. offers opportunities to work with modern automation and control technologies while contributing to complex, technically challenging projects.
Role Description
The Electrical Automation Engineer is a full-time, on-site position based in Newburgh, IN. This role is responsible for designing, programming, and commissioning automation and control systems for industrial equipment and processes. Daily tasks include developing electrical schematics, configuring PLCs and HMIs, integrating sensors and drives, and ensuring proper functionality and safety of automated systems. The engineer will diagnose and resolve control and electrical issues, optimize process performance, and provide technical support during installation, testing, and maintenance. Collaboration with mechanical engineers, project managers, and external partners is expected, along with preparing documentation, reports, and user instructions for installed systems.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Electrical Engineering skills, including familiarity with industrial power distribution, control circuits, and relevant standards.
Candidates should possess Automation and Process Control skills, such as PLC and HMI programming, drive and motion control configuration, and system integration.
Candidates should possess Troubleshooting skills, including systematic fault diagnosis, root cause analysis, and resolution of electrical and control issues.
Candidates should possess Robotics-related skills, including understanding of robotic interfaces, programming basics, and integration into automated production or handling systems.
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience with industrial communication protocols (e.g., Ethernet/IP, Profibus, Modbus) and safety systems is highly beneficial.
Ability to read and create electrical schematics and technical documentation. AutoCad Electrical and/or EPlan experience is a plus.
Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to work safely on-site and collaborate in multidisciplinary teams.

added.title: Software Engineer
added.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer (TS/SCI)

Location: Norfolk / Virginia Beach, VA (on-site, 20 to 30% travel)

Salary: $180,000 to $220,000 base depending on level, plus competitive equity

Our client builds software and hardware that help people on the front lines deter and de-escalate conflict with America's adversaries. Their tools support maritime vigilance, counter misinformation and collect non-traditional intelligence, across all U.S. service branches, multiple combatant commands, partner nations and the intelligence community. They have been profitable since 2021.

The team is mission-driven and believes in public service, and they put serious effort into improving the technology the government uses.

The Role

Our client is hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to be the technical owner for mission-critical national security software deployments. You will sit between engineering and the customer, turning operator requirements into production-grade software deployed directly into government environments. This is hands-on, high-stakes engineering work that shapes U.S. defense outcomes.

What you'll own

Deploying and sustaining production software inside government and DoD IT environments, end to end from requirements through fielding
Acting as the primary technical contact for mission owners, operators and intel analysts, turning ambiguous field requirements into shipped software
Scoping and building low-cost pilots with government mission teams (pre-sales) and running full technical deployments after contract close (post-sales)
Writing hands-on backend code (Python preferred) across customer use cases, including large-scale text, multimedia and geospatial data
Navigating government IT ecosystems (RMF, IdAM, SIEM, CDSs) and working with product, design and platform engineering teams

What We're Looking For

Active TS clearance with SCI eligibility (candidates eligible and willing to obtain clearance may be considered if technically exceptional)
4 to 6 years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture or forward deployed roles within government or DoD environments
Full-stack engineering experience with strong backend fundamentals, Python preferred (assessed through a backend coding and algorithms interview)
Proven experience deploying software inside government or DoD IT environments (RMF, IdAM, SIEM, CDSs)
Ability to own a project end to end in a field-facing or customer-embedded context with minimal oversight
Willingness to travel 20 to 30% to customer and classified operational sites

Tech stack

Python, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS S3, DoD RMF, Government IT systems (IdAM, SIEM, CDS)

If you are open to finding out more about this position, please apply below and I will be in contact to discuss the position further.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world's leading AGI infrastructure companies, working with frontier AI labs to accelerate model development through high-quality training data, evaluations, and engineering talent.

About the Role:

We're looking for a high-taste engineer with a strong eye for quality — someone who's worked hands-on with preference data and rubric creation, and knows what separates a good example from a great one. You communicate clearly and can synthesize complex technical work the way a strong MAI dev would: concise, structured, and easy for others to act on. You're comfortable in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and default to shipping over deliberating.

What does day-to-day look like:

Design, refine, and iterate on rubrics and evaluation criteria for preference data
Review and label data with a high bar for quality, catching subtle issues others might miss
Build and maintain pipelines/infra that support data generation, collection, and evaluation workflows
Synthesize findings from data work into clear write-ups, updates, or recommendations for the team
Collaborate closely with researchers/engineers to translate qualitative judgment into scalable processes

Required Skills:

Proficiency in Python (especially building/maintaining pipelines and infra) or Typescript (experience contributing to or navigating large codebases like VSCode a plus)
Hands-on experience with preference data collection and/or rubric creation
Strong written and verbal communication — able to distill technical work into clear, actionable summaries
Demonstrated high-taste judgment — able to articulate why something is good, not just that it is.

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

Work in a fully remote environment.
Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
